<text x="72.0" y="120.0" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#b45309" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">HuBERT (it. 2)</text>
<text x="72.0" y="142.0" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#b45309" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">fixed · discrete</text>
<text x="72.0" y="168.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">meaningful k-means ids</text>
<text x="72.0" y="188.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">from a previous model</text>
<text x="72.0" y="214.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">collapse: impossible</text>
<text x="72.0" y="240.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">negatives: none</text>
<text x="72.0" y="266.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">iterate: yes,</text>
<text x="72.0" y="286.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">teacher ← student</text>
<text x="72.0" y="312.0" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="auto">fails: teacher's biases</text>
